look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a bare unstyled component, a data-attribute annotation, one list restyled by style skin and mode, a locked named palette, and the Rokkit end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.
